title: Authentication secret operations
responsibility: Derive separate lookup and encryption keys and generate opaque or human-entered codes.

inputs.name: authSecrets.secret
inputs.description: Session secret, UTF-8 encoded, used as the HKDF-SHA256 input keying material for both derived keys. The helper does not check its length or content, and a different secret derives different keys.

inputs.name: normalizeCode.value
inputs.description: Text to uppercase and filter; any string is accepted. Uppercasing runs before the filter, so a non-ASCII character whose uppercase form is ASCII, such as the dotless i (uppercased to I), is kept.

inputs.name: randomToken.bytes
inputs.description: Number of random bytes to draw; it defaults to 32, which encodes to a 43-character token. Negative or infinite counts, and counts too large to allocate, throw RangeError; counts above 65536 that can be allocated throw QuotaExceededError from crypto.getRandomValues.

inputs.name: sha256Url.value
inputs.description: Text to hash, encoded as UTF-8 first; the result is the RFC 7636 S256 transform of this text, so a PKCE code_verifier passed here yields its code_challenge.

inputs.name: safeEqual.left
inputs.description: First string to compare, by UTF-16 code unit; unequal lengths return false before any character is compared.

inputs.name: safeEqual.right
inputs.description: Second string to compare, using the same UTF-16 code-unit comparison and length rule as left.

outputs.name: authSecrets
outputs.description: Helpers: hash(purpose, value) returns a lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of purpose, a newline and value, and seal returns an AES-GCM 'v1' envelope holding a fresh 12-byte IV and the ciphertext, both base64url, with context bound as additional data. The lookup and sealing keys are separate HKDF-SHA256 derivations of the secret, made on first use and kept by the helpers; open returns the plaintext, or null for a malformed value, a wrong context, a value sealed under another secret or failed decryption.

outputs.name: randomToken
outputs.description: Random bytes from crypto.getRandomValues, encoded as unpadded base64url; the default 32 bytes give a 43-character string.

outputs.name: sha256Url
outputs.description: Resolves to the SHA-256 digest of the UTF-8 encoded value, encoded as unpadded base64url and 43 characters long; a rejection of the WebCrypto digest call is not caught here.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True only when the strings are equal; unequal lengths return false at once, and equal-length strings have every character compared with no early exit.

outputs.name: userCode
outputs.description: Eight random characters from the 32-character alphabet of A-Z without I and O plus 2-9, shown as two groups of four joined by a hyphen, so the value is nine characters long. The source comment describes it as a code a person types from the desktop app into the approval page.

outputs.name: normalizeCode
outputs.description: The value uppercased with every character outside A-Z and 0-9 removed, so the result holds only those characters and can be empty.

outputs.name: emailCode
outputs.description: Eight random decimal digits from crypto.getRandomValues, drawn without modulo bias and padded with leading zeros, so the value is always exactly eight characters.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Thrown by randomToken when bytes is negative or infinite, or too large to allocate, because the Uint8Array constructor rejects that length.

errors.name: QuotaExceededError
errors.description: DOMException named QuotaExceededError, thrown by randomToken when bytes is above 65536 and the array could be allocated, because crypto.getRandomValues fills at most 65536 bytes per call.

errors.name: DOMException
errors.description: Rejection, normally a DOMException, from a WebCrypto call this unit does not catch: the digest in sha256Url, and the key import, key derivation, signing and encryption inside the hash, seal and open helpers. Decryption failures in open are caught and return null instead.
